role: entropy of a probability measure P (or its density p) relative to a sigma-finite reference measure mu; value in [-infinity,+infinity] or undefined
notes: Handbook notation for the reference-measure form; Shannon's H(x) is the case mu = Lebesgue measure in the coordinates x.

role: the function t -> -t log t on [0,infinity) with eta(0)=0
notes: Local to the chapter and its annex.

role: Shannon's entropy of the chance variable x (or the pair x,y); x labels the variable and is not a function argument
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 6 p. 11 (label convention) and sec. 20 p. 35.

role: Shannon's conditional entropy of y given x (of x given y) for a joint density
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 p. 35; can be negative in the continuous case.

role: density of the chance variable(s) relative to the stated reference measure; marginal densities by integrating out the other variable
notes: Shannon's notation; the argument names the variable whose marginal is meant.

role: doubly normalized averaging kernel and the averaged density
Gaussian density with quadratic form a; second-moment matrix A = inverse of a; |a_ij| is Shannon's notation for the determinant
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 items 5-6, pp. 36-37; a_{ij} in item 9 denotes a general invertible matrix (local to that corollary).

role: absolute value of the Jacobian determinant of the old coordinates x with respect to the new coordinates y
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 item 8, pp. 37-38; equals 1/j(x) at y=T(x).

role: Jacobian factor of a coordinate change T: int_V g dy = int_U g(T x) j(x) dx
t log(t/s) - t + s, the nonnegative tangent gap used in the annex proofs
side length of a cube in feet, valued in (0,1); \ell^2 and \ell^3 are face area and volume, and \ell^a a power coordinate with a>0
notes: Local to the corollary and the cube comparison in sec:p15-w02b-p15-042-relationships; the same letter is used for side length in thm:p15-w02b-p15-044-cubes.

role: matrix of first partial derivatives of a coordinate change T at x; |det DT| is its Jacobian factor
notes: Local to the chapter and the proof of thm:p15-w02b-p15-042-diffeomorphism.

role: sup norm of a vector in R^n and the induced matrix norm (maximum absolute row sum)
